summary: Ansible 10 breaking changes in community.aws: botocore<1.29.0 and boto3<1.26.0 are no longer supported, ansible-core<2.15 and Python<3.7 support is dropped, and aws_region_info, aws_s3_bucket_info, iam_access_key and iam_access_key_info moved to amazon.aws.
questions: Where did aws_region_info move in Ansible 10?
Which boto3 version does community.aws need in Ansible 10?
